newsitem.title: GERMANY: N.Europe rapeseed prices under pressure.
newsitem.headline: N.Europe rapeseed prices under pressure.

text.p: Rapeseed prices in Northern Europe fell this week as the prospect of a bumper U.S. soybean crop weighed on world prices, brokers said on Friday.
"Traders did not quote buying prices when Chicago futures fell for three consecutive sessions this week," one broker said.
Prices consolidated today, with the U.S. closed for a public holiday and with buyers back in the market, he added.
But prices might fall further due to a lack of consumer demand and favourable crop weather in European rapeseed regions.
New crop buyers for ex-harvest seed were at 440 marks/tonne free Hamburg, 10 marks down on the week.
The fob Baltic price was 435 marks, basis 2,500 tonnes, down five marks.
Rapeseed prices for delivery at points other than Hamburg were in a 427.50-440 marks range for July/August compared with 430-455 quoted last week.
November rapeseed on the Matif futures exchange was untraded in a 443/445 marks range compared with trades at 449 a week ago.
Spot and July rape meal was slightly steadier at 29.50-29.75 marks/100 kg while August-October meal dropped 1.00 to 23.25.
Rape oil sellers were up by 0.75 marks on the week, with July at 94.00 and Aug/Oct at 92.25.
